name: proxyparser
description: Self-hosted Clash/Mihomo subscription management and immutable release console.
author: Paperside

scripts.sync-types: cp backend/src/lib/build-config/types.ts frontend/src/lib/build-config-types.ts && printf '// ⚠️ 生成自 backend/src/lib/build-config/types.ts —— 勿手改，改动后运行 bun run sync-types。\n%s' "$(cat frontend/src/lib/build-config-types.ts)" > frontend/src/lib/build-config-types.ts && cp backend/src/lib/nodes/protocol-schema.ts frontend/src/lib/node-protocol-schema.generated.ts && printf '// ⚠️ 生成自 backend/src/lib/nodes/protocol-schema.ts —— 勿手改，改动后运行 bun run sync-types。\n%s' "$(cat frontend/src/lib/node-protocol-schema.generated.ts)" > frontend/src/lib/node-protocol-schema.generated.ts
